bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast on promotional text in .promo div
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the promotional banner text "Free shipping on orders over $50 this week only"
Inspect the text color (#d9c27a) against its background (#ffe9a8)
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.3.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The text contrast ratio is 1.46:1, which is far below the required 4.5:1.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for div, change color from #d9c27a to #756942 (4.53:1 on #ffe9a8; measured 1.46:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Missing language attribute on <html> element
steps_to_reproduce: Observe that there is no lang attribute
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The <html> element must have a valid BCP 47 language code in a lang attribute (e.g., <html lang="en">) so assistive technologies can determine the page language.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <html> element is rendered as <html> without a lang attribute.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a lang attribute with the appropriate language code to the root element, e.g., change <html> to <html lang="en">.

bugLogs.title: Missing alt text on hero image on home page
steps_to_reproduce: Inspect the page source or use a screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The image must have a text alternative (alt attribute) that conveys its purpose, or be marked as decorative with role="presentation" or alt="".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no alt attribute, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no role override.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute, e.g., alt="Summer sale hero banner showing discounted products", to img[src='hero-summer-sale.jpg']

bugLogs.title: Icon-only cart link missing accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Tab through the page until the cart link is focused
Listen with a screen reader or observe that no link text is announced
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The link should have a discernible accessible name that is announced by screen readers and visible to assistive technologies.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element is focusable but has no visible text, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add an accessible name, e.g., , or include visible text inside the link.

bugLogs.title: Missing label for email newsletter signup input
steps_to_reproduce: Focus on the email input field
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The email input should have a persistent visible label (or aria-label/title) that is announced by screen readers and remains visible when the field receives focus.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The input has only a placeholder text "Your email address" with no associated <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a visible label element and associate it with the input: <label for="news-email">Email address</label> placed before the <input id="news-email" ...>. Alternatively, add aria-label="Email address" to the input if a visible label cannot be used.
